== example linear_error_reporting
-- log
fact: (root dependency)
derived: root
attempting root 0
fact: root depends on foo ~> 1.0
fact: root depends on baz ~> 1.0
selected root 0
derived: baz ~> 1.0
derived: foo ~> 1.0
attempting foo 1.0.0
fact: every version of foo depends on bar ~> 2.0
selected foo 1.0.0
derived: bar ~> 2.0
attempting bar 2.0.0
fact: every version of bar depends on baz ~> 3.0
conflict: true
conflict: every version of bar depends on baz ~> 3.0
backtracking to 1
derived: not bar >= 0
conflict: every version of foo depends on bar ~> 2.0
! not bar ~> 2.0 is satisfied by not bar >= 0
! which is caused by every version of bar depends on baz ~> 3.0
! thus every version of foo requires baz ~> 3.0
! foo >= 0 is satisfied by foo ~> 1.0
! which is caused by root depends on foo ~> 1.0
! thus baz ~> 3.0 is required
! not baz ~> 3.0 is satisfied by baz ~> 1.0
! which is caused by root depends on baz ~> 1.0
! thus version solving has failed
-- result
failure:
version solving has failed
  baz ~> 3.0 is required
    every version of foo requires baz ~> 3.0
      every version of foo depends on bar ~> 2.0
      every version of bar depends on baz ~> 3.0
    root depends on foo ~> 1.0
  root depends on baz ~> 1.0
-- explanation
Because every version of foo depends on bar ~> 2.0
  and every version of bar depends on baz ~> 3.0,
  every version of foo requires baz ~> 3.0.
So, because root depends on foo ~> 1.0
  and root depends on baz ~> 1.0,
  version solving has failed.
== example branching_error_reporting
-- log
fact: (root dependency)
derived: root
attempting root 0
fact: root depends on foo ~> 1.0
selected root 0
derived: foo ~> 1.0
attempting foo 1.0.0
fact: foo < 1.1.0 depends on a ~> 1.0
fact: foo < 1.1.0 depends on b ~> 1.0
selected foo 1.0.0
derived: b ~> 1.0
derived: a ~> 1.0
attempting a 1.0.0
fact: every version of a depends on b ~> 2.0
conflict: true
conflict: every version of a depends on b ~> 2.0
! a >= 0 is satisfied by a ~> 1.0
! which is caused by foo < 1.1.0 depends on a ~> 1.0
! thus foo < 1.1.0 requires b ~> 2.0
! not b ~> 2.0 is satisfied by b ~> 1.0
! which is caused by foo < 1.1.0 depends on b ~> 1.0
! thus foo < 1.1.0 cannot be used
backtracking to 1
fact: foo < 1.1.0 cannot be used
derived: not foo < 1.1.0
attempting foo 1.1.0
fact: foo >= 1.1.0 depends on x ~> 1.0
fact: foo >= 1.1.0 depends on y ~> 1.0
selected foo 1.1.0
derived: y ~> 1.0
derived: x ~> 1.0
attempting x 1.0.0
fact: every version of x depends on y ~> 2.0
conflict: true
conflict: every version of x depends on y ~> 2.0
! x >= 0 is satisfied by x ~> 1.0
! which is caused by foo >= 1.1.0 depends on x ~> 1.0
! thus foo >= 1.1.0 requires y ~> 2.0
backtracking to 1
fact: foo >= 1.1.0 requires y ~> 2.0
derived: y ~> 2.0
derived: x ~> 1.0
conflict: foo >= 1.1.0 depends on y ~> 1.0
! not y ~> 1.0 is satisfied by y ~> 2.0
! which is caused by foo >= 1.1.0 requires y ~> 2.0
! thus foo >= 1.1.0 cannot be used
! foo >= 1.1.0 is satisfied by not foo < 1.1.0
! which is caused by foo < 1.1.0 cannot be used
! thus version solving has failed
-- result
failure:
version solving has failed
  foo >= 1.1.0 cannot be used
    foo >= 1.1.0 depends on y ~> 1.0
    foo >= 1.1.0 requires y ~> 2.0
      every version of x depends on y ~> 2.0
      foo >= 1.1.0 depends on x ~> 1.0
  foo < 1.1.0 cannot be used
    foo < 1.1.0 requires b ~> 2.0
      every version of a depends on b ~> 2.0
      foo < 1.1.0 depends on a ~> 1.0
    foo < 1.1.0 depends on b ~> 1.0
-- explanation
    Because every version of x depends on y ~> 2.0
      and foo >= 1.1.0 depends on x ~> 1.0,
      foo >= 1.1.0 requires y ~> 2.0.
(1) So, because foo >= 1.1.0 depends on y ~> 1.0,
      foo >= 1.1.0 cannot be used.

    Because every version of a depends on b ~> 2.0
      and foo < 1.1.0 depends on a ~> 1.0,
      foo < 1.1.0 requires b ~> 2.0.
    And because foo < 1.1.0 depends on b ~> 1.0,
      foo < 1.1.0 cannot be used.
    So, because foo >= 1.1.0 cannot be used (1),
      version solving has failed.

== example no_versions
-- log
fact: (root dependency)
derived: root
attempting root 0
fact: root depends on foo ~> 1.0
selected root 0
derived: foo ~> 1.0
attempting foo 1.0.0
fact: every version of foo depends on bar ~> 2.0
selected foo 1.0.0
derived: bar ~> 2.0
attempting bar 
fact: no versions satisfy bar ~> 2.0
conflict: no versions satisfy bar ~> 2.0
backtracking to 1
derived: not bar ~> 2.0
conflict: every version of foo depends on bar ~> 2.0
! not bar ~> 2.0 is satisfied by not bar ~> 2.0
! which is caused by no versions satisfy bar ~> 2.0
! thus foo cannot be used
! foo >= 0 is satisfied by foo ~> 1.0
! which is caused by root depends on foo ~> 1.0
! thus version solving has failed
-- result
failure:
version solving has failed
  foo cannot be used
    every version of foo depends on bar ~> 2.0
    no versions satisfy bar ~> 2.0
  root depends on foo ~> 1.0
-- explanation
Because every version of foo depends on bar ~> 2.0
  and no versions satisfy bar ~> 2.0,
  foo cannot be used.
So, because root depends on foo ~> 1.0,
  version solving has failed.
